preselection: Only contemporaneously verified non-event history and features available strictly before decision may rank or exclude candidates
fixed_set: Freeze the selected three identifiers before opening outcomes or post-decision contamination
post_decision_census: Audit the frozen +5-day contamination window afterwards; unknown/contamination makes the fixed set unmatched for confirmatory analysis
replacements: Forbidden after post-decision audit, even when other candidates are available
reason: Clarify the preregistered contamination audit boundary; future announcements cannot improve control selection
